agency: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (MARD), Republic of Valdoria (fictional agriculture ministry)

tenure_documents.owner_title: Property title number (the registry checks it against the land registry automatically)
tenure_documents.lease: Signed lease or rental agreement covering at least one full season, with the landowner's national ID number
tenure_documents.cooperative: Assignment letter from the cooperative with the plot reference
tenure_documents.informal: Tenure declaration signed by the producer and two witnesses, endorsed by the municipal agriculture officer

programs.name: Smallholder Inputs Package
programs.summary: Certified seed and fertiliser for staple crops, delivered at the municipal agro-service centre in March 2027.
programs.benefit: Seed for up to 1 ha of staples plus 2 bags (45 kg) of fertiliser per hectare, up to 3 ha

programs.name: Fertiliser Voucher
programs.summary: 50% voucher on fertiliser at accredited agro-dealers, one voucher per producer per season.
programs.benefit: 50% of the price of up to 4 bags (45 kg) per hectare, up to 10 ha

programs.name: Parametric Crop Insurance
programs.summary: Rainfall-index insurance; pays automatically when 30-day rainfall falls below 60% of the 20-year average.
programs.benefit: Payout up to $350 per insured hectare

programs.name: Coffee Renovation Credit
programs.summary: Credit to renovate rust-affected or old coffee plots through the national development bank.
programs.benefit: Up to $2,500 per hectare at 3% a year, 5 years with 2 years' grace
